evals.prompt: Generate the weekly digest using the campaign log, hot cache, and live Aruhe entity and session pages. Separate new from updated pages, exclude system/raw/archive/digest pages, and ground the headlines, themes, connections, open threads, and reread recommendations in the page evidence.
evals.expected_output: A newsletter-style digest that synthesizes actual knowledge, reports new and updated counts, excludes system material, and gives evidence-grounded themes, connections, open threads, and concrete reread reasons.

assertions.text: Correctly identifies new versus updated pages from the requested period
Excludes system directories, _raw, archives, and previous digest pages
Headlines synthesize actual knowledge rather than listing files or ingestion events
Themes, connections, open threads, and recommendations are grounded in vault evidence
Each reread recommendation explains why the older page became newly relevant

evals.prompt: Generate the normal weekly digest from the campaign log and hot cache for a vault where three active Aruhe entity pages have visibility/pii tags and two public pages are active. Do not include private titles or connections. Then describe what changes when the user explicitly requests full/private mode.
evals.expected_output: Default output counts private activity without leaking titles, content, or connections; explicit full/private mode includes those pages normally.

assertions.text: Default digest exposes no private page titles, content, or connections and reports only a private count
Explicit full/private mode includes private pages normally

evals.prompt: Generate and save the weekly digest grounded by the campaign log and hot cache. Write it under journal/, update the campaign index, append the digest log entry, and update the manifest as if it were a source ingestion.
evals.expected_output: An explicitly saved digest under journal with index and log updates, while .manifest.json remains unchanged.

assertions.text: Normal chat mode does not create a journal page, while explicit save mode does
Explicit save writes under journal/, updates index.md, and appends the correct log entry
Does not alter .manifest.json because digests are not source ingestions

evals.prompt: Generate a weekly digest for the Aruhe Caves owner and three other active campaign pages, for a period with only four active pages. Produce a substantial newsletter anyway so the user gets value immediately.
evals.expected_output: The skill stops, reports the sparse period, and offers a wider period instead of fabricating a substantial digest.

assertions.text: Stops when fewer than five pages are active
Offers a wider period rather than fabricating themes, connections, or recommendations

evals.prompt: Generate a digest for the Aruhe campaign slice using the explicit custom period "last 14 days". Distinguish pages created in that period from older pages updated in that period, and label the resulting date range in the digest.
evals.expected_output: A 14-day digest with correct inclusive period parsing, separate new/updated classification, and a matching period label.

assertions.text: Parses the custom "last 14 days" period rather than defaulting to seven days
Separates newly created pages from older pages updated within the custom period
Reports the correct start/end period in the digest header

evals.prompt: Generate the digest for an Aruhe period that spans a wiki rebuild. Page timestamps reflect the post-rebuild state, while the campaign log records the rebuild during the period. Include the rebuild context in the digest instead of treating all page dates as ordinary learning activity.
evals.expected_output: A grounded digest that notes the wiki rebuild and explains that page dates reflect post-rebuild state while still reporting the period's knowledge activity accurately.

assertions.text: Detects that the requested period spans a wiki rebuild from the campaign log
Includes the documented rebuild context and post-rebuild timestamp caveat in the digest
Does not misrepresent rebuild timestamp churn as ordinary new knowledge
